newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy household confidence index rises in July.
newsitem.headline: Italy household confidence index rises in July.

text.p: Confidence in the economy among Italian households rose in July after a fall in June, economic research body Isco said on Monday.
Isco's latest monthly confidence index rose to 114.1 from 108.9 in June and fell to 115.0 in July 1996.
The survey of expectations for the economy over the next year showed increased optimism, and little change in the inflation outlook since last month.
But two-thirds of respondents thought the economic situation had worsened compared with July last year.
A higher percentage said they intended to buy durable goods while the number of people planning to buy homes or cars was unchanged.
